mapper.select:
SELECT p.pno, name, addr, type, thumbnail, category, hit, f.f_count, r.r_count, l.l_count FROM place p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pno, COUNT(*) as f_count FROM favorite GROUP BY pno ) f ON p.pno = f.pno
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pno, COUNT(*) as r_count FROM review GROUP BY pno ) r ON p.pno = r.pno
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pno, COUNT(*) as l_count FROM userlike GROUP BY pno ) l ON p.pno = l.pno
category = '식당'
AND name LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
AND addr LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
ORDER BY
f.f_count DESC
l.l_count DESC
hit DESC
r.r_count DESC
pno DESC
pno ASC
OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 16 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/8.0) FROM place WHERE category = '식당'
